notes.title: “Knowledge Park - All World” Big Update Released!
notes.notes:
Awesome! The best English, Spanish, Portuguese learning game for kids!

In this version, we have added:
[list]
[*] The ability to learn English, Spanish, Portuguese with voiceover.
[*] Voice assistant in 4 languages throughout the game.
[*] Renewed our design and made it more simple and attractive.
[/list]

Thank you for choosing our game!

notes.title: Update from Jan, 12 2023
notes.notes:
Awesome, big update!! In this version, we have added the ability to learn Spanish and Portuguese and renewed our design and made it more simple and attractive. 
If you like this version, please leave a rating or review. Thank you for choosing our app!

notes.title: April 26, 2022 Update - Unique educational game for kids
notes.notes: Thank you for choosing our app! In this version, we renewed our design and made it more simple and attractive. We also updated the game engine Godot Engine to version 3.4.4. We will be glad to receive your feedback.
